name: Kolaboro corrections log
how_to_request: Email hello@kolaboro.com with the project page link, what you think is wrong and the evidence (a document, a registry extract or a dated photo). We reply within 10 working days.

audits.what: Accuracy check: 50 projects drawn at random (sample fixed by a monthly seed) and every one of their 485 tested claims re-checked against the cited source by a separate automated run that had not done the original research. Not a human audit; a human review of the same sample is next.
audits.second_pass: 25 claims could not be read on the first pass; on a second pass 22 held up, 1 was wrong and 2 remain unchecked.
